tasting_notes: Rums aged at least 7 years blended and barrel-aged 30-45 days with syrup, macerated raisins and distilled water. Caramelised raisin, vanilla, chocolate, soft oak.
Sweet aged Cuban rum infused with spices, raisins and macerated plums. Complex wood aroma from long aging mixed with dried fruit.
Double-aged rum blended with exotic flavours and warming spices: ripe guava, fresh pineapple, toasted green coconut, sweet vanilla. Flavored spirit drink.
White rum flavored spirit drink balancing tropical mango with citrus lime.
